cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've closed my book too. Final chapter. Before you leave, we say the book-club closing words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was clearing space for my coat. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coats first. I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we can leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll come to your window. Give me ten seconds of your taxi time; I only need you through 'until next time.'

reason: Make copied book closing a mistaken formal cue. Keep B's car suggestion as an accepted accommodation while A maintains the brief mutual ritual.
